Household.title: Household
Household.description: Stores a family's smog lifestyle profile and daily completed actions.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated household owner.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the household city.

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the household city.

indoorFiltration.description: Whether the household has an indoor air purifier.

vulnerableMembers.description: Whether kids or seniors live at home.

completedActionsToday.description: Bounded list of action IDs completed today (max 10).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the household profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the household profile was last updated.

CommunityImpact.title: CommunityImpact
CommunityImpact.description: Aggregated anonymized neighborhood smog action metrics per city.

citySlug.description: Normalized city identifier matching the document ID.

familiesCount.description: Total families taking action in this city today.

co2AvoidedKg.description: Cumulative kg of CO2 avoided locally today.

noxAvoidedGrams.description: Cumulative grams of NOx avoided locally today.

recentActions.description: Bounded list of up to 10 recent anonymized action strings.

lastActionBy.description: UID of the authenticated user who recorded the latest action.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest neighborhood action.

/households/{userId}.description: Per-family lifestyle profile and daily completed habit IDs, isolated to the authenticated household owner.

/community_impact/{citySlug}.description: Real-time neighborhood impact counter and anonymized action ticker per city.
